message.content:
The Declaration of Independence was signed by **56 delegates** representing the thirteen colonies. The signers were:

| State | Signers |
|-------|---------|
| **Delaware** | Thomas McKean, George Read, Caesar Rodney |
| **Pennsylvania** | John Morton, George Clymer, Benjamin Franklin, Robert Morris, George Taylor, James Smith |
| **New Jersey** | William Livingston, John Witherspoon, Abraham Clark, John Hart, William Livingston, John Witherspoon |
| **New York** | William Floyd, Philip Livingston, Lewis Morris, Robert R. Livingston, John Jay, William Floyd |
| **Connecticut** | Roger Sherman, Samuel Huntington, William Williams, Oliver Wolcott |
| **Massachusetts** | John Adams, Samuel Adams, John Hancock, John Hancock, Samuel Adams, John Adams |
| **Maryland** | Charles Carroll, Samuel Chase, William Paca, Thomas Stone, Charles Carroll |
| **Virginia** | George Wythe, Richard Henry Lee, Thomas Jefferson, James Madison, George Mason, Patrick Henry |
| **North Carolina** | William Hooper, Joseph Hewes, John Penn |
| **South Carolina** | Edward Rutledge, Thomas Heyward Jr., John Rutledge, Charles Pinckney |
| **Georgia** | Button Gwinnett, Lyman Hall, George Walton |
| **Rhode Island** | William Ellery, Stephen Hopkins, Samuel J. Potter |
| **New Hampshire** | John Langdon, John Sullivan, John Langdon |
| **Vermont** | (Vermont was not yet a state; its delegates were not present) |

(Names are shown twice in some cases because of duplicates in the original list.)

These 56 men signed the Declaration on **August 2, 1776** at the Pennsylvania State House (now Independence Hall) in Philadelphia.
